angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 967,575 km at 29.92 pc = 0.43 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 33.4250 +/- 0.0223 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 29.92 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.391 (1.363 to 1.419) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 967,575 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.130 (1.090 to 1.170) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5982 +/- 1.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3101382419728401408: teff_gspphot 5981.8096 K (16th-84th percentiles 5980.145-5983.5635), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3101382419728401408: teff_gspphot 5981.8096 K (16th-84th percentiles 5980.145-5983.5635), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/citala.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.205, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 52265 (pscomppars): spectral type G0V, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 52265: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 52265 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.21 dex, from Naef et al. 2001 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2001A&A...375..205N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 52265 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.297, from Naef et al. 2001 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2001A&A...375..205N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 52265 (pscomppars): age 3.5 Gyr, from Naef et al. 2001 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2001A&A...375..205N/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/469/309/table2 (Chromospheric activity in late-type stars), column Prot: 9.42 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.391 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.696. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
